name: Form Threshing (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses ThreshingRecordService::create()/update() (BE service shared with screen-049)

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): the Threshing Detail grid is now DYNAMIC -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() now exist on FormThreshing.php, exactly mirroring FormCagesTrack's Cages Tipped Time grid. Grid starts empty on create mode (was: built from ThreshingRecordService::canonicalTimeSlots() into 24 rows on mount); edit mode still loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 6 reading-column inputs per row are genuinely editable number/text fields, never disabled -- Threshing has no computed detail-grid fields (for comparison, Form Cages Track Web's Total Cages/Cages Remain, formerly disabled inputs, have been rendered as plain text since 2026-10-04), so the 'no disabled web inputs' rule applies with zero exceptions in this screen; enforced statically by tests/Feature/Livewire/WebFormNoDisabledFieldTest.php
Target Operasional table queried directly by FormThreshing::render(), never sent as part of the create/update payload
Route /data/threshing/create registered BEFORE /data/threshing/{id} (screen-053) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormCagesTrack's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By, unlike Form Weighbridge/Grading Web which only have Acknowledged)

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): ThreshingRecordService::create() memanggil assertPeriodOpenForWrite('threshing', station->business_unit_id, date) setelah validasi & resolve station dan sebelum penulisan pertama; update() memanggilnya dua kali (tanggal lama record dan tanggal baru dari body) setelah findOrFail/cek akses/validasi — jadi memindahkan record keluar dari periode tertutup juga ditolak. Penolakan = PeriodClosedException 422 PERIOD_CLOSED dengan salah satu dari 4 pesan (belum ada periode / masih Draft / sudah ditutup / di luar rentang + rentang yang berlaku), nol baris tersimpan. FormThreshing::save() menangkap HttpException dan menampilkan pesannya sebagai alert halaman ($generalError). Test yang menutupnya: tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan + cek statis ke-18 service) dan tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php (end-to-end via Sterilizer); test per-layar (tests/Unit/Services/ThreshingRecordServiceTest.php, tests/Feature/Api/FormThreshingTest.php, tests/Feature/Livewire/FormThreshingTest.php) membuka periode Terbuka sebagai prasyarat via openPeriodFor()/openPeriodForStation(). test_results tidak diubah (suite tidak dijalankan ulang untuk sinkronisasi ini).

REVISI v4 (2026-10-03, uji ditambahkan — kode produksi tidak diubah): tests/Feature/Api/FormThreshingTest.php kini punya 3 uji HTTP kunci periode per-stasiun yang menutup celah 'penolakan kunci periode hanya diuji end-to-end via Sterilizer': (1) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat POST bertanggal di periode tertutup, tanpa menyimpan satu baris pun'; (2) 'kunci periode: menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED saat PATCH record yang tanggal lamanya di periode tertutup walau tanggal barunya di periode terbuka, dan record tidak berubah'; (3) 'kunci periode: menerima 201 saat POST tepat pada tanggal awal dan tanggal akhir periode terbuka (inklusif)'. Ketiganya mengganti periode prasyarat dengan sepasang periode tertutup + terbuka lewat helper replacePrerequisiteWithClosedAndOpenPeriods() di tests/Pest.php. Berkas kini 19 uji, semuanya hijau (test_results.integration diperbarui).
